updates.content: We have scheduled maintenance affecting NBN services delivered via the Caboolture (4CAB) and Ipswich (4IPS) POIs in Brisbane. This work will take place on Thursday, 13 August, between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST. Some customers on these POIs may experience brief interruptions while we move connections to a new router. We will monitor closely and aim to keep any downtime to a minimum. Services are expected to be fully restored by 2:00 AM AEST. Note: these works have been rescheduled to this time.

The previously advised maintenance window for NBN services in the Caboolture (4CAB) and Ipswich (4IPS) areas remains unchanged. Planned works are still scheduled between 12:00 AM and 2:00 AM AEST on Thursday, 13 August 2026. No additional updates at this time.
